category.name: Internal tools and low-code apps
category.description: Build admin panels, operational apps and workflows over databases and APIs.
category.audience: Operations and IT teams, developers and business teams building bespoke internal software
category.audienceRationale: Cross-industry use, but direct buyers are teams creating custom internal software rather than every employee.

pricing.note: Team: $10/builder/month and $5/internal user/month, billed annually; free plan for up to five users. Usage and higher tiers differ.

oss.name: Appsmith
locked: More than three Git repositories and custom environments
Custom access roles, audit logs, SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM
oss.classificationReason: Apache-2.0 Community core; commercial editions separately gate workflow building and reusable packages, so C rather than enterprise-only B.

health.rsx: Central analysis available; overall 6/10. Automated dependency findings not independently validated; not a security endorsement.

oss.name: ToolJet
locked: Self-host free plan: two builders, up to 50 end users, up to ten apps
Version control, Git sync, custom styling, themes and modules
Custom groups, audit logs, SSO and air-gapped deployment
oss.classificationReason: AGPL Community core, not a claim about commercial Enterprise code. Official self-host pricing gates ordinary development and deployment functions, therefore C. Pricing-plan caps may depend on distributed edition; source-build entitlements need confirmation.

health.rsx: Central analysis available; overall 6.5/10. Automated dependency findings not independently validated; not a security endorsement.

oss.name: Budibase
locked: Open source limited to one workspace
Built-in backups and restore, environment variables and custom branding
Enforced SSO, user groups, Active Directory/SCIM and audit logs
oss.classificationReason: GPLv3 core and MPL-2.0 generated-app packages; paid packages/pro uses non-OSI BSL. Unlimited OSS apps/users/actions, but one workspace plus paid backup/environment capabilities warrant C.

health.rsx: Central analysis available; overall 5.5/10. Automated dependency findings not independently validated; not a security endorsement.
